---
title: "How to add an analysis"
---

## Folder layout

Copy `analyses/_template/` to a new folder under `analyses/` with this name form:

`YYYY-MM-short-name`

Example: `2026-08-scmd-unit-dose-columns`

Quarto does not render folders that start with an underscore, so the template stays out of the site.

Inside the folder:

- `index.qmd` — the report and main analysis

## Report sections

Each report should include:

1. Question
2. Data
3. Method
4. Findings
5. Limitations

## Shared environment

Use the repository `uv` environment. Do not create a separate environment for each report.

```shell
uv sync
uv run ruff check .
uv run pytest
```

## Rendering

Render the full site from the repository root:

```shell
uv run quarto render
```

The project sets `freeze: true`. A full project render never executes code.
To refresh results, render the report directly:

```shell
uv run quarto render analyses/YYYY-MM-short-name/index.qmd
```
